message.content:
This document is the README for **Project Maya**, a system for running large open models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) locally on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Models & Quantization**
- Three model families with Maya quants (XS/S/M/L sizes) plus third-party options (unsloth GGUF, EXL3, abliterated variants).
- Quality measured against originals: GLM-5.3 quants retain 97.7–99.2% zero-shot accuracy
